What is Zarude?

These Zarude are a group of /-type Pokémon appearing in the "Secrets of the Jungle". They are a group of Zarude that lived together in the Forest of Okoya while one of them left to raise Koko as his own son.

Bullet Seed; Grass; MS023: Pokémon the Movie: Secrets of the Jungle
